560-2034-5220-6961-8347.notablePrerequisites: You control ten or more lands that have different names.
560-2034-5220-6961-8347.description:
Activate Survey Mechan by sacrificing it.
When Survey Mechan dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Survey Mechan from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Sela triggers, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Survey Mechan ability, dealing 3 damage to any target and causing you to draw three cards and gain 3 life.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing the two creature tokens, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Cast Survey Mechan by paying {4}.
Repeat.

4446-4681-5170-8249.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Cleric
4446-4681-5170-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Karmic Guide.
When Karmic Guide dies, Relic Vial triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Relic Vial trigger.
Resolve the Relic Vial trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Karmic Guide from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Karmic Guide enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

261-1409-8160.description:
Activate Kwia by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Kwia enters, Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Suture Priest trigger.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Kwia.
Resolve the Suture Priest trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Kwia triggers, creating a Lotus token.
Activate the Lotus by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {U}{U}{U}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

728-5189-6972.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Ghave.
When Ghave dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat.

618-997-6132.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, targeting Metamorphosis Fanatic
Holding priority, activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Kiki-Jiki
Resolve the Kiki-Jiki ability, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic with haste.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Kiki-JIki from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

348-1152-4867-6248-7548.easyPrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
348-1152-4867-6248-7548.description:
Cast Traitorous Greed by paying {3}{R}.
Forum Necroscribe triggers, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve Traitorous Greed, untapping Priest of the Forgotten Gods, giving it haste until end of turn, and adding {R}{R}.
Activate Priest of the Forgotten Gods by tapping it, sacrificing Cormela and any creature not part of the combo.
When Cormela dies, it and Phenomenon Investigators triggers.
Resolve the Cormela trigger, returning Traitorous Greed from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Phenomenon Investigators trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Priest of the Forgotten Gods ability, causing any number of opponents to sacrifice a creature and lose 2 life, adding {B}{B}, and drawing a card.
Repeat, sacrificing the newly created token in step 4 instead of the additional creature.

549-1274-2685-5641.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
549-1274-2685-5641.description:
Gain life in any way.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token that enters the battlefield as an artifact due to Biotransference.
Teething Wurmlet triggers, causing you to gain life.
Repeat from step 2.

2946-4871-5256-6255.notablePrerequisites:
A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
You have max speed.
2946-4871-5256-6255.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Zahur trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature you control

1878-2713-3454-6811-7654.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has six or more cards in hand.
1878-2713-3454-6811-7654.description:
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Jeska's Will and casting it without paying its mana cost, adding at least six {R}.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sunforger by paying {R}{W} and unattaching it, searching your library for Big Score and casting it without paying its mana cost and discarding a card.
Resolve Big Score, causing you to draw two cards and create two Treasures.
Activate Sunforger's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to Zirda.
Activate Sundering Archaic twice by paying {2}, putting Big Score and Jeska's Will from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse

4668-6072-7182.notablePrerequisites: Opponents have drawn at least four cards this turn.
4668-6072-7182.description:
Cast Graveshifter for its evoke cost by paying {0} due to Heliod
When Graveshifter enters, its first ability and evoke abilities trigger.
Resolve the first trigger, optionally returning a card from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the second trigger, sacrificing Graveshifter.
When Graveshifter dies, Ashling triggers, creating a token copy of Graveshifter with haste.
When the Graveshifter token enters, it triggers, returning Graveshifter from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

56-5075-5256-6887.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional untapped black and/or green creature.
56-5075-5256-6887.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing Hogaak.
When Hogaak dies, Ogre Slumlord and The Skullspore Nexus trigger, creating two creature tokens.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing you to mill eight cards.
Cast Hogaak from your graveyard by exiling five cards from your graveyard and tapping two black and/or green creatures you control.
Repeat.
56-5075-5256-6887.notes: Once you've milled your library, you may repeat the loop as the number of cards in your graveyard allows and decide to mill another player.

4186-4268-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
4186-4268-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Scurry Oak.
Scurry Oak triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters the battlefield, Kor Celebrant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 2.

4659-5003-5147-6644.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Ancient Adamantoise.
When Ancient Adamantoise dies, it and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Ancient Adamantoise from your graveyard to the battlefield and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Resolve the Ancient Adamantoise trigger, creating ten tapped Treasure tokens.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks twice by sacrificing two Treasures, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

2506-2721-2921.description:
Cast Bloodline Necromancer by paying {4}{B}.
When Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it and Molten Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Bloodline Necromancer trigger, returning a Vampire or Wizard creature card from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Bloodline Necromancer.
Resolve the Molten Echoes trigger, creating a token copy of Bloodline Necromancer with haste.
When the token Bloodline Necromancer enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning the nontoken Bloodline Necromancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Emet-Selch, Unsundered // Hades, Sorcerer of Eld

513-2104-6333.manaNeeded: {1}{U}{B} plus enough mana to cast the extra turn spell each turn
513-2104-6333.notablePrerequisites: You have at least thirteen cards in your graveyard.
513-2104-6333.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation from your graveyard by paying its mana cost.
Hullbreaker Horror triggers, returning Hades from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve Temporal Manipulation, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Emet-Selch by paying {1}{U}{B}.
When Emet-Selch enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to loot.
At the beginning of your upkeep during your extra turn, Emet-Selch triggers, transforming itself into Hades.
Repeat.

710-1052-5147.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Danitha.
When Danitha dies, Minion's Return triggers, returning Danitha from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
When Danitha enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Minion's Return from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Danitha.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Repeat.

574-4944.description:
Activate Vish Kal's second ability by removing all +1/+1 counters from it, targeting any creature.
Crackdown Construct triggers, giving itself +1/+1 until end of turn.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability, giving the targeted creature -1/-1 until end of turn for each counter removed from Vish Kal.
Repeat.
Once you have an infinitely large Crackdown Construct, you may sacrifice it to Vish Kal's first ability to put infinite +1/+1 counters on it.

5095-5299.description:
Cast Out of Time by paying {1}{W}{W}.
When Out of Time enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to untap all creatures and phase them out until Out of Time leaves the battlefield.
Because Opalescence causes all non-Aura enchantments to become creatures, it and Out of Time also phase out.
Because Out of Time is phased out, and has no way to phase back in, all permanents phased out by it are permanently phased out.

1806-2445-4204-5296.description:
Activate Varolz by sacrificing Eternal Scourge, regenerating Varolz.
Activate Eternal Scourge's scavenge ability by paying {3} and exiling it, putting six +1/+1 counters on Workhorse.
Activate Workhorse six times by removing six +1/+1 counters from it, adding {6}.
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.

2100-3120-5195.notablePrerequisites: Mindsplice Apparatus has at least four oil counters.
2100-3120-5195.description:
Cast Searing Touch with buyback by paying {R}.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve Searing Touch, dealing 1 damage to any target and returning it to your hand.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1409-2060-4020-4929.notablePrerequisites:
Your commander on the battlefield.
Crystalline Crawler and Cryptic Trilobite have at least one +1/1 counter on them.
Deadeye Navigator is paired with your commander.
1409-2060-4020-4929.description:
Activate your commander by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
Your commander enters the battlefield, triggering Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability and Norn's Choirmaster.
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator, repairing it and your commander.
Resolve the Norn's Choirmaster trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Cryptic Trilobite and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Cryptic Trilobite's first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}{C} that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Repeat.

2267-4788-5256.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two cards in your graveyard.
2267-4788-5256.description:
Activate Psychatog's second ability by exiling two cards from your graveyard.
Tormod triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Resolve Psychatog's ability, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing the Zombie token, causing yourself to mill cards equal to the Zombie's power.
Repeat.

751-914-2397.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least two artifacts and/or enchantments.
751-914-2397.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, creating at least four Treasure tokens.
Activate three Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}{R}.
Cast Shrieking Drake by paying {U}.
Shrieking Drake enters the battlefield, triggering its ability twice, returning itself and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
